text:
jess_sales: Hey team — onboarding for Velora (POC). They want a hosted API key scoped to a single workspace, IP allowlist, and a 48h TTL for demo access. Any blockers?

sam_platform: That sounds doable. We usually issue a short-lived key + ip allowlist tag. Need to confirm rate limits; if they spike we can fallback to a dedicated pool but that requires sales sign-off.

alexa_se: Quick Q: will the client run long-running background jobs during the demo? 48h TTL will break any cached creds in CI.

jess_sales: They have a small batch job that polls every 10s for inference results for ~12h. Concerned about rotation mid-run.

tina_devex: For the CI/cache issue, recommend using the SDK's automatic refresh hook + a refresh endpoint. But hosted short-lived keys are not automatically rotated by SDK unless you implement a refresh token flow.

ryan_security: Security notes: IP allowlist + 48h TTL is fine for POC, but we should add an audit log entry + require the key to be tagged "poc:velora" and "sales:owner=jess" so we can find it for revocation. Also mark data retention as demo-ltd in the tenant.

sam_platform: Implementation plan: create API key scoped to workspace velora-poc, add metadata tags (poc, sales_owner), set expire_at unix timestamp +172800s. Add a network_restrictions array with their CIDR block.

jess_sales: They asked about rotation during the demo — if we rotate the key at T+24h, will their job fail?

alexa_se: If we rotate out the old key and don't provide a new one programmatically, yes. Options: (1) issue a fresh 48h key and tell them to update by hand, (2) provide an ephemeral refresh token flow so their CI exchanges it for a current key, (3) schedule rotation to happen during low activity window and send a Slack/Email notice.

jess_sales: They prefer no manual steps during demo. Option 2 sounds best but they don't want to build refresh. Can we do an intermediary short-lived "guest" token that our team can auto-rotate and proxy?

sam_platform: We can issue a proxy token under our support account and rotate behind the scenes, forwarding requests to hosted API. Downsides: increases support burden and adds an indirection in audit logs. Need security approval.

ryan_security: Proxying is allowed for demos if documented and audited, but we must: (a) record the original customer identity in logs, (b) set an explicit expiration and (c) limit the proxy token to only the exact endpoints needed (no admin scopes).

jess_sales: OK — plan: we try native short-lived hosted key + SDK refresh guide first. If Velora can't adopt it, we set up support proxy for the demo window.

tina_devex: For the SDK guide, I'll draft a small snippet they can drop in CI. Example: ```js
// ephemeral-key refresher (pseudo)
async function fetchKey() {
  const res = await fetch("https://redwood.example.com/poc-keys/velora/fetch");
  const { key, expires_at } = await res.json();
  // store in env, use with Redwood SDK
}
```
I'll add a note about token caching and TTL safety.

sam_platform: For ops: steps I'll take now: 1) Create hosted key p:velora-demo with tags, expire_at=178418? (48h), network_restrictions=Velora CIDR. 2) Add audit note and contact. 3) Add rotation hook and create revocation button in console for you, Jess.

jess_sales: Sweet. Can you also add a reminder to revoke immediately post-demo and to confirm if they need logs retained? They asked for anonymized logs for troubleshooting.

ryan_security: We can provide anonymized request/response metadata for 30 days, but not raw PII. We'll add that to the provisioning ticket.

infra-bot: deploy-ticket #P-7643 created by sam_platform for velora-poc hosted key provisioning. link: https://redwood.atlassian/issue/P-7643

jess_sales: Thanks all — I'd appreciate the SDK snippet and the console revoke link. I'll coordinate the demo time with Velora (tentative Wed 9am PST).

sam_platform: Will update ticket with console link + steps. ETA: 2 hours.

tina_devex: Draft guide posted to the ticket. Short checklist included: 1) Add IP to allowlist 2) Drop SDK refresher 3) Test key after creation 4) Revoke post-demo.

jess_sales: Perfect, closing loop. If anything unexpected pops up ping me. :thumbsup:
